document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
after: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

text: Some people believe that ordinary people can do very little to protect the environment, and that governments and big companies should take the main responsibility. I partly agree with this view, but I think individuals also have an important role to play. This is an important issue because the environment affects the health and future of all of us.

On the one hand, governments and companies have much more power than individuals. A government can make laws that limit pollution, and it can build public transport and recycling centres for everyone. Big factories produce a huge amount of waste and smoke, so they must be controlled by strict rules. For example, in many cities the air is dirty mainly because of heavy industry and traffic, and one person cannot solve this problem alone.

On the other hand, individuals can make a real difference when many of them act together. If people use buses instead of cars, save electricity and recycle their rubbish, the total result is very large. In addition, people are customers, so companies often change their products when the public asks for it. For instance, many shops now sell cloth bags because shoppers do not want to pay for plastic ones, and this has reduced the amount of plastic waste.

In my opinion, the best results come when everybody works together. Governments should make clear rules, companies should produce less waste, and individuals should change their daily habits. In conclusion, the main responsibility belongs to governments and companies, but ordinary people should not ignore the problem, because small actions can also help our planet. Therefore, a combined effort is the only realistic way to deal with environmental problems.

document.title: Who should protect the environment?
document.question:
Many people believe that individuals can do very little to protect the environment, and that governments and companies should take the main responsibility.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?
